name: Lucius
source:
It is unknown where Lucius came from or who he is.

All that’s known is that he gets his way, no matter what.

He has a smile on his face whether he’s insulting you or complimenting you. No one’s sure when he’s serious, or when he’s joking.

Very charming and convincing.

[From the [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/10C18D9dLZ_jKI1p7anhfTTnWz5Nkdzt36bNyxHIqcFQ]casting submission form[/url]]
